versions.changelog: Security hardening: HTTPS required, path traversal protection, payload size limits, localhost-only binding, strong token guidance. Updated docs with Cloudflare Tunnel/ngrok/Tailscale Funnel setup. Added App Store link.

Initial release of scanwow-sync.

- Enables syncing OCR scans from the ScanWow iOS app directly to your OpenClaw agent workspace.
- Provides setup instructions for starting a secure HTTP webhook server.
- Supports secure API export using a token for authentication.
- Details the JSON payload structure sent from ScanWow for seamless document transfer.
- Designed for easy integration via your iPhone's camera and the ScanWow app.
